slides.headline: What is full doc lending?
slides.body: Full doc lending is based on complete financial documentation, typically two or more years of accountant-prepared statements and tax returns. This depth of information gives lenders greater confidence, which can translate into access to larger loan amounts, longer terms and more competitive pricing for established businesses.

caption:
Complete financials take more effort to pull together, but they can also do more work for you.

With two or more years of accountant-prepared statements and tax returns, lenders have the confidence to offer larger amounts, longer terms and often sharper pricing than a low doc equivalent, though outcomes depend on your overall profile and the lender.

Have strong financials ready? Let's see what they could unlock.

General information only. This does not constitute financial, legal, accounting or tax advice. Credit is subject to lender assessment, eligibility and approval criteria. Fees, charges, terms and conditions may apply.
